The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the changes made:

**internal/candidate/operations.go:**
- Added `reopenOp` with:
  - Name: "reopen.v5"
  - Role: "requester" (only authenticated requesters can reopen)
  - Own: true (only the creator can reopen their own purchase)
  - From: "rejected", To: "submitted" (only rejected purchases can be reopened)
  - Field: "" (empty because this is a single-target operation, not batch)
  - Event: action.NoEvent (no event needs to be emitted)

**internal/candidate/approval.go:**
- Added `item` function to convert action.Operation to protocol.ItemHandler
- Updated `New` function to register the reopen endpoint using `protocol.Item("reopen", "requester", item(executor, reopenOp), fallback)`
- Created a unified handler that routes to either bulk endpoints or the reopen endpoint, with all other requests going to the fallback

The implementation:
- Uses the shared HTTP adapter `protocol.Item` for the reopen endpoint
- Validates authentication (401 if not authenticated)
- Validates role is "requester" (403 if approver or other role)
- Validates request body contains `{"reason":"..."}` with 1-200 bytes
- Validates Idempotency-Key header
- Only allows requester to reopen their own rejected purchases in their tenant
- Returns 200 with `{"id":ID,"status":"submitted"}` on success
- Handles idempotency through the Action kernel
- All other APIs (bulk-approve, bulk-reject) remain unchanged
